registers: WHAT CAPTURABILITY DOES AND DOES NOT BUY. Written before the C1 bisection reported and before any C2 change was made, so the outcome can be graded rather than described.
background: probe_cudagraph_feasibility.py measured a structural asymmetry: the dequant-on-forward baseline captures into a CUDA graph 4/4 (H100, 4090; now 4090+H100+A2000), and gnf4's fused training path fails 8/8, in isolated processes. probe_graphed_race.py then showed the consequence -- at training shape the fused path LOSES to a graphed baseline on both devices, and the leg-4 speed headline died to it. The claim that survived is memory, not speed.

the_registered_position.capturability_is_a_PRECONDITION_not_a_wi: Making the fused path capturable removes an asymmetry. It does not produce a speedup, and no number in this directive's scope may be reported as one. The fused path being capturable puts it in the same class as the baseline; it does not put it ahead.
the_registered_position.dynamic_shapes_are_the_real_barrier: MoE routing makes group sizes and hit-expert sets a function of token content, so they change every step. A CUDA graph replays a FIXED launch sequence over FIXED buffers. Capturability therefore buys nothing usable without padding or bucketing the routing metadata to a static shape, and padding has its own cost (lora_delta_grouped already falls back to a per-expert loop past _PAD_WASTE_LIMIT=4.0 for exactly this reason). Nothing in C1-C2 addresses this.
the_registered_position.what_C1_C2_would_establish: That the fused path CAN be captured -- i.e. that the call path contains no host round-trip that is illegal during capture. That is a property of the call path, not a measurement of anything, and its correct report is a boolean plus the named hazards, not a ratio.

prohibited_reports: Reporting capture success, or any wall-clock number obtained by replaying a captured fused graph, as a speedup, an improvement, or a win.

Comparing a captured fused replay against an UNgraphed baseline. probe_graphed_race.py registered the honest race as graphed-vs-graphed or shipped-vs-shipped; a captured fused arm against an ungraphed baseline is the same error in the opposite direction, and it is the error this project has already made once.
Citing capturability as evidence that the leg-4 headline is restored. It is not: the graphed race's verdict stands until a NEW registered experiment replaces it.

what_a_throughput_claim_from_graphing_wo.own_prereg: Registered pre-data, with the predicted direction and bar stated before the run.
what_a_throughput_claim_from_graphing_wo.own_padding_or_bucketing_scheme: Named and fixed before the data, including how many buckets, how routing metadata is padded, and what the padding waste is per cell. A scheme chosen after seeing the numbers is a tuned result, not a measurement.
what_a_throughput_claim_from_graphing_wo.own_fidelity_gate: The padded/bucketed path must produce the same values as the unpadded one to the registered tolerance. Padding a grouped GEMM changes which rows the kernel touches; a speed number from a path that computes something different is not a speed number.
what_a_throughput_claim_from_graphing_wo.both_arms_graphed: The baseline is capturable today. Any race that graphs one arm must graph the other or say in the headline that it did not.

C2_regression_gate_registered_here.bar: fast_train and fast_train_dgrad reproduce their measured e2e training ratios within the registered self-pair band 0.967-1.032, on at least one device, before any capturability change merges.
C2_regression_gate_registered_here.basis: bench/phase1/results/dequant_forward/RESULTS-e2e-training.md, prereg kernel/prereg_dequant_forward_e2e.json. Text+resident fast_train_dgrad measured 4.504x (4090) and 4.746x (H100); random-ids+offload, the weakest cell, 1.806x / 2.378x.
C2_regression_gate_registered_here.rationale: A capturability fix that costs throughput is not a fix. The call-path changes in scope (hoisting index-tensor construction out of the per-call path) should be neutral-to-positive; if they are not, the change does not merge.
C2_regression_gate_registered_here.stop_rule: If the regression gate fails, the change is reverted and the failure is written into the results doc. No re-running for a better number.

kernel_math_untouched: C2 is a call-path change only. No Triton kernel source, no tiling constant, no dispatch threshold, and no numeric path moves. The fidelity suite must be bit-identical across the change; a fidelity delta means the scope was exceeded.
how_this_can_fail: If C1 cannot isolate the cause -- if capture still fails with every named hazard removed -- then C2 does not proceed, the third hazard is the deliverable, and this registration stands unused rather than being loosened to fit.
